answer: Snapshot as of October 3, 2026. (1) September 30, 2026: Cal-Maine reported fiscal Q1 2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026): net sales USD 539.6 million (-41.5% from USD 922.6 million), gross profit USD 0.4 million, operating loss USD 82.2 million and a net loss attributable of USD 58.6 million, or USD 1.26 per diluted share, versus net income of USD 199.3 million (USD 4.12) a year earlier [H20-E1][H20-E3]. Conventional shell egg net sales fell 59.5% on a 59.3% lower average selling price (segment loss USD 71.0 million); Specialty Shell Eggs and Prepared Foods rose to 54.1% of net sales [H20-E1]. (2) Under the variable dividend policy no dividend is payable for the quarter; USD 94.5 million of cumulative loss must be recovered before any future dividend [H20-E1]. (3) Buybacks: 66,601 shares for USD 5.0 million in the quarter (USD 315.7 million left of the USD 500 million program) and 204,888 shares for USD 14.9 million after quarter end [H20-E1]. (4) On August 31, 2026 (8-K filed September 2) the company entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement: a five-year senior unsecured revolver of up to USD 250 million (accordion up to another USD 250 million), maturing August 31, 2031, with nothing borrowed at September 1 [H20-E2]. **Question:** What has Cal-Maine Foods reported or announced in the 30 days before October 3, 2026 about its quarterly results, shareholder returns and financing? Give dates and key figures.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 FY2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026) | 539,607 [1] | 403 [1] | (82,165) [1] | (58,615) [1] | (1.26) [1] |
| Q1 FY2026 (13 weeks ended August 30, 2025) | 922,602 [1] | 311,314 [1] | 249,184 [1] | 199,340 [1] | 4.12 [1] |

- Cal-Maine Foods reported its first quarter fiscal 2027 results on September 30, 2026, for the quarter ended August 29, 2026, with all comparisons to the comparable period of fiscal 2026. [1][2]
- For Q1 FY2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026), net sales were $539,607 thousand, down 41.5% from $922,602 thousand in Q1 FY2026 (13 weeks ended August 30, 2025), as reported (GAAP). [1]
- Q1 FY2027 gross profit was $403 thousand versus $311,314 thousand in Q1 FY2026, a decrease of 99.9%, as reported (GAAP). [1]
- Q1 FY2027 operating loss was $82,165 thousand versus operating income of $249,184 thousand in Q1 FY2026, as reported (GAAP). [1]
- Q1 FY2027 net loss attributable to Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. was $58,615 thousand and diluted loss per share was $1.26, versus net income attributable of $199,340 thousand and diluted EPS of $4.12 in Q1 FY2026, as reported (GAAP). [1]
- The Q1 FY2027 decline was driven by a 59.3% decrease in average conventional shell egg selling price per dozen, with volume relatively flat, producing a Conventional Shell Eggs segment loss of $71,045 thousand versus segment income of $168,236 thousand in Q1 FY2026. [1]
- In Q1 FY2027, Prepared Foods accounted for 11.7% of net sales compared to 7.8%, and combined Specialty Shell Eggs and Prepared Foods increased to 54.1% of net sales compared to 37.1%. [1]
- Pursuant to its variable dividend policy, Cal-Maine Foods will not pay a cash dividend with respect to the first quarter of fiscal 2027, and as of August 29, 2026 the cumulative loss to be recovered before payment of any future dividend was $94.5 million. [1][3][4]
- Cal-Maine Foods repurchased 66,601 shares of its common stock under its current share repurchase authorization during the first quarter of fiscal 2027 for a total of $5.0 million. [1][3]
- The repurchase program permits up to $500 million, of which $315.7 million remained available as of the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2027 (August 29, 2026). [1][3]
- Subsequent to the end of the first quarter, Cal-Maine Foods repurchased 204,888 shares under the repurchase program for $14.9 million. [1][3]
- On September 2, 2026, Cal-Maine Foods filed an 8-K reporting that on August 31, 2026 it entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement providing a senior unsecured revolving credit facility of up to $250 million, which matures on August 31, 2031. [5]
- As of September 1, 2026, no amounts were borrowed under the Credit Facility and $5.9 million in standby letters of credit were issued under it. [5]
- On September 9, 2026, Cal-Maine Foods announced it would report its fiscal 2027 first quarter results at approximately 6:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, with a conference call and webcast at 9:00 a.m. ET the same day. [6]

- Q2 FY2027 quarterly results (quarter ending November 28, 2026): Q2 FY2027 is still in progress as of October 3, 2026 and has not been reported; the only quarterly results in the 30-day window are Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended August 29, 2026). [1][2]
- Q2 FY2027 guidance or quantitative outlook: The Q1 FY2027 release and call provide only qualitative forward-looking commentary (e.g., timing of conventional shell egg market rebalancing and Prepared Foods capacity growth) with no Q2 FY2027 revenue or earnings guidance figures. [1][7]
